title: Controlled Substance Stewardship policy: fills granted on a controlled renewal
content:
**Section 1 — Fills of a controlled renewal.** A controlled renewal of the Prescriptions & Renewals line approved from hold authorizes the smaller of the class's refills per authorization plus one and the whole number of fills of the prescription's per-fill days' supply that fit in the class's total days' supply per authorization, rounded down. The fills are posted at the prescription's per-fill days' supply on the renewal date, and the fills left on the old authorization are voided as superseded when the new fills are granted.

**Section 2 — Assembly.** The fills a controlled renewal authorizes are the reach fills, plus the reserve fills, less the database-check withholding, plus the adherence adjustment, plus the follow-up adjustment, never more than the class's refills per authorization plus one and never fewer than one. The reach fills are the class fills of Section 1; the reserve fills are 0; the database-check withholding is 0; the adherence adjustment and the follow-up adjustment are each 0.

**Section 3 — Terms used.**
- *Per-fill days' supply* — the per-fill days' supply recorded on the prescription on the renewal date.
- *Fit, rounded down* — the class's total days' supply per authorization divided by the per-fill days' supply, any fraction of a fill dropped.
- *Never more / never fewer* — after the components are totalled, a figure above the class's refills per authorization plus one is brought down to it, and a figure under one is raised to one.

**Section 4 — Worked figures (hypothetical prescriptions).**

| Class (refills per authorization; total days' supply) | Per-fill days' supply | Refills plus one | Whole fills that fit | Fills authorized |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Schedule III-V Controlled Prescription (5; 180) | 30 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Schedule III-V Controlled Prescription (5; 180) | 14 | 6 | 12 | 6 |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription (0; 90) | 30 | 1 | 3 | 1 |

**Section 5 — Old fills.** The fills left on the old authorization are voided as superseded when the new fills are granted; they are not added to the new fills.
